headline: Community forum on Ends Policy update, plus VSBA superintendent evaluation contract and accounts payable over $50K.
summary: The meeting includes a community forum on first drafts of the Ends Policy update and a closed executive session. Action items cover contract signatories, an Act 170 merger committee member, and the superintendent evaluation contract.
items: Closed executive session on employment, attorney-client communication, labor negotiations, and real estate
Focus on student learning: student representative report
Community forum: first drafts of Ends Policy update and initial questions about NESDEC Best Use Study
Discussion: revised Executive Limitation 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities (first reading)
Action: designate authorized contract signatories and delegate contracting authority under 16 V.S.A. § 563(16)
Action: designate a board member to serve on Act 170 merger committee
Action: approve VSBA Superintendent Evaluation contract
Action: Monitoring Report 2.2 Treatment of Staff
Action: Monitoring Report 2.1 Treatment of Students and Parents/Guardians
Superintendent's report: review of summer work
Consent agenda: accounts payable over $50K, AP voucher checks, payroll warrants, one-year staff hires, and set agenda for August 19, 2026 meeting; review future agenda items
location: South Burlington School District, 577 Dorset Street
